lessons.title: Identify your skills
lessons.subtitle: One small skill to practise
lessons.body:
List things you have done in work, education, volunteering or everyday responsibilities. Describe a concrete example rather than only a label. Compare those examples with the requirements in a job description.

Practise: explain one action from this lesson in your own words. Then complete all three quiz questions to unlock the next lesson.
lessons.sourceName: Reference for further reading; prototype adaptation

questions.explanation: In this situation, a concrete example is the useful choice. List things you have done in work, education, volunteering or everyday responsibilities. Describe a concrete example rather than only a label. Compare those examples with the requirements in a job description.

questions.prompt: Where can useful experience come from?
questions.explanation: In this situation, work, study or volunteering is the useful choice. List things you have done in work, education, volunteering or everyday responsibilities. Describe a concrete example rather than only a label. Compare those examples with the requirements in a job description.

questions.prompt: What should you compare your skills with?
questions.explanation: In this situation, the job requirements is the useful choice. List things you have done in work, education, volunteering or everyday responsibilities. Describe a concrete example rather than only a label. Compare those examples with the requirements in a job description.

lessons.title: Build an honest CV
lessons.subtitle: One small skill to practise
lessons.body:
Use clear sections for contact details, relevant experience and education. Describe your contribution accurately and check for mistakes. Share only the personal information needed for the application.

Practise: explain one action from this lesson in your own words. Then complete all three quiz questions to unlock the next lesson.

lessons.title: Read the vacancy
lessons.subtitle: One small skill to practise
lessons.body:
Read the responsibilities, required skills and application instructions. Verify the employer through an independent channel when possible. Do not pay a stranger for a promise of employment.

Practise: explain one action from this lesson in your own words. Then complete all three quiz questions to unlock the next lesson.
lessons.sourceName: Reference for further reading; prototype adaptation

questions.explanation: In this situation, the application instructions is the useful choice. Read the responsibilities, required skills and application instructions. Verify the employer through an independent channel when possible. Do not pay a stranger for a promise of employment.

questions.prompt: How can you check an unfamiliar employer?

lessons.title: Prepare an application
lessons.subtitle: One small skill to practise
lessons.body:
Tailor the application to the role using truthful examples. Use the requested format and a clear file name. Save a copy of what you submitted and keep track of the application date.

Practise: explain one action from this lesson in your own words. Then complete all three quiz questions to unlock the next lesson.

lessons.title: Practise an interview
lessons.subtitle: One small skill to practise
lessons.body:
Prepare examples of how you handled a task or solved a problem. Practise answering clearly and prepare questions about the role. An interview invitation does not justify sending account passwords or paying a job-guarantee fee.

Practise: explain one action from this lesson in your own words. Then complete all three quiz questions to unlock the next lesson.
